objective: Replace the retired VoxCPM2 desktop TTS runtime with pinned k2-fsa OmniVoice on CUDA, preserve the fixed owner-authorized Hina synthetic voice, reduce resident and peak VRAM, and prove one real Vietnamese synthesis before deleting VoxCPM2 weights and runtime dependencies.
non_goals: Do not open a public or arbitrary voice-cloning endpoint.
Do not fine-tune OmniVoice from the raw voice_demo folder in this maintenance slice.
Do not use an unverified community quantization or silently fall back to CPU.
Do not claim commercial readiness while OmniVoice pretrained weights remain CC-BY-NC.
Do not run the deferred M08 OCR or VLM implementation in this slice.
contracts: OmniVoice is CUDA-only in Hina and loads the pinned official checkpoint in float16 without its optional Whisper ASR.
Voice cloning uses only the SHA-256-bound transcript-aligned owner-created synthetic Hina reference; arbitrary reference enrollment remains disabled.
Long Vietnamese output is bounded by outer sentence chunking and OmniVoice audio-duration chunking, with batch size one and complete pre-TTS moderation.
The provider records CUDA resident and peak memory, releases cached allocator blocks after inference, and unloads deterministically on scheduler preemption or shutdown.
The shared scheduler retains at least 2048 MiB global VRAM headroom.
VoxCPM2 is removed from active code, dependencies, provenance registry, local model cache and the Python environment only after OmniVoice real synthesis passes.
allowed_dependencies: omnivoice==0.2.1 from the official k2-fsa PyPI release at Git commit 5ba967c4d5b0f08244ae856b033eea583d1e4517.
Existing PyTorch CUDA 12.8, torchaudio, soundfile, NumPy, Accelerate and Hugging Face Hub runtime.
Existing Hina scheduler, moderation, fixed voice manifest and TTS service contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The default desktop TTS status reports OmniVoice 0.2.1, CUDA, float16, 24 kHz, ASR disabled and the fixed Hina reference hash.
A real short Vietnamese WAV using the Hina voice is finite, non-silent and saved under var/tmp for owner listening.
A real multi-sentence Vietnamese WAV completes without corrupt partial segments.
The benchmark records cold load, warm synthesis, process CUDA allocated/reserved peaks and global free VRAM on the RTX 5070 Ti.
Configured scheduler reservation is based on the measured OmniVoice peak and still preserves the 2048 MiB headroom contract.
VoxCPM2 provider code, dependency, active manifests and all verified local weight caches are gone; only clearly marked historical reports may retain its name.
Focused speech unit tests, governance provenance tests and desktop typecheck/startup smoke pass once.
